normalization: Every feature divided by max(1,committed_round_count), matching legacy prefix. Store raw unnormalized counts and requested/completed/refused separately. Train/holdout use same names/order/normalization; no holdout feature selection.

raw_observation_schema.restriction: Only exact observer-visible public bytes. Raw event command/advice/topic text/actor-side response outside public channel never becomes a feature. Missing fields represented explicitly, never imputed from hidden state. Public epoch/privatecard/privateactorlist/peerreason fields are structural blockers even if classifierAUC passes.

feature_extraction: Channel observations/frame counts and rawUTF8byte counts as recorded; revisions/stream fields numeric first/last/delta, server_time actual last-first; UUIDpresence counts/pathsets and value-change count retain observable identity metadata without adding secret raw labels. epoch/sequence values only if public; forbidden publicepoch triggers structuralFAIL. state transitions count actual serialized state changes; missingpresentflag0, numericmissing0 with raw missing marker retained. Generic classified by current_round.kind=generic, not hiddenprivate flag. HTTP status features only for observer-accessible public requests.
public_card_order: Frozen fixture creation array Qpublicascending,TDpublicascending,YBpublicascending,Q9000; retain mixedquarantined public histogram entry zero. No privatecards in histogram.
old_features: Exact old named groups/order retained; values now derive actual V2 projections/transitions instead of fabricated legacy RoundPlan/revisionincrements. Legacy elapsed_ticks=number of scheduled deterministic100ms clock ticks plus explicit5001ms jumps as recorded tickevents, not invented emitted framecount.
redaction: Store observer public bytes exactly before any redaction; credential/cookie/token/secret appearing there causes stop/quarantine, never sanitize it into statisticalPASS. Artifact paths contain only synthetic identities; no real session secrets exported. Actor preaccept raw/projection tests kept separately and are deterministic, not extra inference transcripts.
artifact_budget: Count bytes beforewrite including NDJSON/hash manifest/chunks; no silent truncation/success-only rows.32GiB hardstop retainedNOT_ACCEPTED.
